contract.intended_consumer: Brian and coding agents starting consequential Agentic Engineering work
contract.outcome: A selected repository rejects a structurally incomplete new plan before coordination mutation and admits an exact declared-structure plan with an inspectable epistemic frontier, reassessment contract, and explicit coverage non-claim.

canonical_journey.starting_state: The plan validator reports outcome, behavioral example, critical-path class, and capability adoption as nonblocking warnings, while plan-start readiness checks only graph state.
canonical_journey.input: One configured incomplete Plan 125-or-newer fixture and one complete Planning Integrity 1.0.0 plan with an exploration row.
canonical_journey.action: Resolve one full Git start revision once, run the shared validator and sanctioned plan-start boundary against both exact plans, and carry only that revision through claim, worktree, and session creation before any protected mutation.
canonical_journey.observable_result: The incomplete plan returns a typed fail with no coordination mutation; observe mode permits but exposes the same findings; the complete declared structure returns a digest-bound pass whose revision is retained identically by the claim, tracker, and worktree, retains its frontier and reassessment fields, and states that omitted material areas or optimality are not mechanically proven.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Missing, malformed, duplicated, or ambiguous semantic fields pass; a non-portable plan path is silently reinterpreted; structural PASS is presented as proof of material completeness or optimality; observe mode hides findings; checker or installed-import errors appear compliant; an older passing caller revision can claim a different branch/worktree; mutable HEAD selects different revisions between readiness and creation; installed templates omit the gate; compatibility work breaks historical plans or unplanned-light work; or a duplicate planning/runtime owner is introduced.
